cases.purpose: Check pid future-child namespace inode semantics and idempotent repeated PID request.
cases.oracle: Direct native unshare syscall and independently retained proc namespace inode and child PID observations.
cases.comparison: Native setup must succeed; candidate return status and proc observations are retained separately.

files.inner.sh:
[[ $UID == "$EUID" && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/ns_guest_identity_r1.py || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
if ((EUID==0)); then
  mapfile -t maps </proc/self/uid_map || exit 125
  (( ${#maps[@]} == 1 )) || exit 125
  read -r a b n tail <<<"${maps[0]}"; [[ $a == 0 && $b == 2000 && $n == 1 && -z $tail ]] || exit 125
else ((EUID==2000)) || exit 125; fi
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/ns-future-children-pid-r2.py
[[ $(type -t ns) == builtin ]] || exit 99
/usr/bin/mkfifo "$HOME/future.fifo" || exit 98
exec 8<>"$HOME/future.fifo" || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" snapshot "$BASHPID" future-before.json || exit 98
ns unshare pid >"$HOME/first.out" 2>"$HOME/first.err"; a=$?
printf 'first=%s\n' "$a" >"$HOME/future-status.raw"
printf 'first=%s\n' "$a"
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" hold <"$HOME/future.fifo" >"$HOME/child.out" 2>"$HOME/child.err" & child=$!
cleanup() { printf 'done\n' >&8; wait "$child"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
ready=0
for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do
  if [[ -s $HOME/future-child.json ]]; then ready=1; break; fi
  kill -0 "$child" 2>/dev/null || break
  /usr/bin/sleep 0.05
done
[[ $ready == 1 ]] || { printf 'child observation incomplete\n' >&2; exit 98; }
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" snapshot "$BASHPID" future-mid.json || exit 98
ns unshare pid >"$HOME/repeat.out" 2>"$HOME/repeat.err"; b=$?
printf 'repeat=%s\n' "$b" >>"$HOME/future-status.raw"
printf 'repeat=%s\n' "$b"
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" snapshot "$BASHPID" future-after.json || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" compare pid
